hypothesis: KO and PEP share a durable defensive-beverages factor; unusually large temporary deviations in their log-price relationship can mean-revert without relying on the market's direction.

data_contract.source: Dukascopy M1 BID aggregated to official NYSE regular trading sessions

frozen_rule.beta: rolling OLS slope over the previous 60 completed common sessions, including signal close and excluding all future observations
frozen_rule.entry: when abs(zscore[t]) >= 2.0, enter both legs at next common session open in the mean-reversion direction
frozen_rule.exit: next common session open after abs(zscore close) <= 0.5, or after 10 held sessions
frozen_rule.stop: next common session open after abs(zscore close) >= 3.5
frozen_rule.sizing: equal dollar gross notional per leg at entry; whole shares; no pyramiding; one pair at a time
frozen_rule.signal_observability: all decisions use completed closes; all fills use the following common open

economics.gross_exposure: 100 percent of equity split equally across both legs
economics.commission_stress: USD 1.00 minimum per order, four orders per completed pair trade
economics.slippage_stress: 10 bps adverse per leg per side
economics.short_borrow_stress: 5 percent annualized on short market value for actual calendar holding days
economics.financing: no leverage and no credit for short-sale cash

robustness_after_candidate_only: entry threshold neighbourhood 1.8 and 2.2 without selecting a new winner
formation window neighbourhood 40 and 80 without selecting a new winner
cross-provider adjusted-close direction and signal-date agreement
SQ/Python signal and fill parity where SQ can express the paired construction
prohibitions: No parameter change after performance is observed.
No OOS opening if validation fails.
No candidate claim from train performance alone.
No live or paper authorization from this experiment.
